title: kithctl watch: accountId 'me' rejected — kithd requires 'a-self'
description: watch.rs fetch_and_notify sends accountId='me' in Message/changes and Message/get requests (lines 414, 464, 643). kithd rejects any accountId that is not 'a-self' or the owner's numeric ID (kith-chat handlers line 210, 770, etc.). A kithctl watch session will receive accountNotFound errors on every state change and never display a notification. The bootstrap also uses 'me', so watch exits with 'bootstrap failed' immediately on a deployed kithd.
